turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, so tell me who decided that and on what basis.
Thanks for coming in. I owe you an apology: the zero went in before I called you.
Okay. Procedure 4.2 says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered, so we agree it shouldn't be there. Was Owen heard before you entered it?
I am withdrawing the zero today. Owen does a private supervised rewrite at lunch. Nothing goes on his record. I will email you that tonight.
"Withdrawing the zero today." Okay, I'm writing that down. If there's no zero, then on what basis does Owen rewrite anything at all?
Here it is in writing, signed.

I'll read every line before I accept anything, and I'll want the words "nothing goes on file" in it exactly. You still haven't answered me, Hale. If the zero is gone, why is my son rewriting his essay?
Thank you for your time, Ms. Kalinowski.
We're not finished. You've given me a signed page and no reason for a rewrite. Answer the question, or I'm walking upstairs to the principal's office with it.
That's not an answer, Hale. Either you tell me why Owen is rewriting an essay you've just withdrawn the zero on, or the principal hears this from me before my call at 4:40.
